newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks shrug off Nomura news to close higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks shrug off Nomura news to close higher.

text.p: Tokyo stocks swung into positive territory to end higher on Friday, as buy backs in futures emerged to prop up cash stocks which were dashed by Nomura Securities Co Ltd's disclosure that its directors had been involved in apparently irregular deals, brokers said.
The Nikkei 225 ended 157.41 points or 0.87 percent higher at 18,198.74, after slumping to a low of 17,836.99. Its March futures added 200 points to 18,220.
"There had been rumors about the activities for quite a while and now that the news is out, the market is relieved," said Akishige Ishikura, a Dai-ichi Securities analyst.
